contradictions.title: READY vs NOT_READY: repair-wave verdict vs validation-campaign verdict
contradictions.statement_a: FINAL REPAIR WAVE: READY_FOR_REAL_PROJECT_TRIAL — deferred items explicitly excluded from the claim (0 blocking product defects, WSL 0F, Windows remaining failures all ledgered deferred).
contradictions.statement_b: Validation campaign: NOT_READY for a full-surface real-project trial — 7 FAIL_PRODUCT cases with WRONG_ANSWER / SILENT_DATA_LOSS / INDEX_DIVERGENCE classifications not proven to be oracle defects.
contradictions.working_reconciliation: The two verdicts differ in chronology and scope: the repair wave closed at e7edc34; the campaign then audited the full surface (golden + public-real + cross-platform + adversarial) at d8f08a4 and applied a stricter verdict rule to semantic-correctness failures the repair wave never targeted. Both may be simultaneously true under their own scopes. Adjudication owner: A4 (fw-context auditor) in R1; A0 final ruling in R6/R7.
contradictions.resolution_required_for: R7_DECISION (determines what 'substrate readiness' actually means for the Agent MVP)

contradictions.title: Root cause of the G03 helper failure: conditional wrapping vs single-line emptiness
contradictions.statement_a: F-V1-002 originally attributes the empty stored body to a function defined inside a file-level conditional group.
contradictions.statement_b: F-V1-007 amends the trigger: any single-line definition stores source='' (G13 has no conditionals at all and shows the same emptiness); the G03 'helper' was an instance of single-line emptiness, not conditional wrapping.
contradictions.working_reconciliation: F-V1-007 explicitly amends F-V1-002; keep F-V1-002's G03 verdict, adopt the broadened trigger. No further action; recorded so later rounds do not re-litigate the narrower reading.

contradictions.title: get_vector_table empty result: test-fixture artifact vs real product gap
contradictions.statement_a: FR-NEW-4 diagnosed a get_vector_table-empty test failure as TEST_FIXTURE (asm test hard-codes clang -E; graceful per-unit skip on clang-less hosts is contracted honest behavior; gcc-shim counter-proof 8/8).
contradictions.statement_b: F-V2-001 establishes a real product gap on the same tool: get_vector_table falsely reports 'No vector table' for the standard CMSIS6 C-template form (typedef'd function-pointer array with cast first element) — a WRONG_ANSWER with no oracle defect found, while the assembly form IS recognized.
contradictions.working_reconciliation: Not a logical contradiction (different fixtures/forms) but a proven conflation hazard: an empty get_vector_table result can be either contracted-honest or a false absence claim. Any roadmap item touching vector tables must treat these as separate work items. Adjudication owner: A4 in R1.
contradictions.resolution_required_for: R2/R4 (vector-table fault scenarios), R7 roadmap scoping

contradictions.title: Substrate maturity vs goal authority (standing anti-anchor tension)
contradictions.statement_a: Extensive completed work exists on fw-context (validation campaign, repair wave, closeout) — a strong pull toward 'finish the tool first'.
contradictions.statement_b: The authoritative goal is the Fault Discovery Agent; the seed itself warns 'Do not infer that fw-context must be perfected before the top-level Agent starts', and GOAL_CONTRACT.md lists making fw-context a standalone best-in-class product as a non-goal.
contradictions.working_reconciliation: This is the standing bias the review must test (ANTI_ANCHOR items 1 and 5: completion bias, sunk cost). Not resolvable at R0; drives R5 (red team) and the R7 anti-anchor answer. A0 rule: every proposed fw-context fix must state its impact on fault/rule discovery or it is not roadmap-critical (EVIDENCE_RULES).

notes: Registered per STATE_MACHINE.md: a phase closes only if unresolved contradictions are registered (they are, with owners). C-01 is the load-bearing contradiction for this review's decision; C-04 is the standing anti-anchor tension that R5 must attack explicitly.
